status: design proposal; no installation, receiver, SDK import or integration executed

interpreter.platform: macOS aarch64, local selected runtime; no host dylib closure claim

dependency_scope: These are exact proposed package versions, not an executed resolution or wheel custody lock. Preserve every original wheel/METADATA/hash and validate the complete transitive closure and Requires-Python before a separate install command is reviewed.

The eight OTel names/versions are based on the official OTel release and author-published package metadata. API/SDK/exporter require Python>=3.10; semantic-conventions 0.66b1 is not the resource-conventions 1.44.0 document version.

opentelemetry-proto 1.45.1 packages generated OTLP v1.10.0 code; use this exact generated reader in the test receiver. No grpc package, auto instrumentation, collector binary, credentials plugin or configuration extras are selected.

The other eight candidate dependency versions are observed as installed metadata in the separate Tablespec Python3.12 environment and proposed for a fresh Python3.11 resolution. Do not copy site-packages or infer target-runtime compatibility from that observation.

Existing qualified Spark/Delta/GraphFrames, psycopg, schema and compiler environments remain untouched; the Python3.9 core remains dependency-free. Native-workflow claims require a later same-profile qualification, not evidence transfer from a synthetic receiver.

environment_policy.process: fresh venv, explicitly selected interpreter, isolated import path; no inherited PYTHONPATH, user-site, OTEL_*, proxy or native SDK environment
environment_policy.sdk: owned providers with explicit Resource/scope/sampler/limits/exporter endpoints; no default detectors or global auto instrumentation
environment_policy.http: explicit test-only loopback endpoint allocated by receiver; pass private session with environment/proxy discovery disabled; finite body, response, retry and whole-close limits must be demonstrated
environment_policy.secrets: synthetic sentinel headers only, no real credentials; secret representations and endpoint values absent from artifacts
environment_policy.receiver: reviewed stdlib HTTP test receiver using exact installed opentelemetry-proto generated request/response classes, parses actual SDK-exported bytes, one owned local listener; not a handcrafted producer and not a claim about a vendor Collector deployment

next_owned_files_proposal.host: ashlar_host.config typed DiagnosticsConfig, ashlar_host.diagnostics sanitized capture/retrieval, ashlar_host.otel optional SDK owner; exact APIs and cleanup transport reviewed before runtime command

next_owned_files_proposal.tests: separate synthetic receiver/process-control tests; existing native runner, compiler, publication and ACK semantics unchanged

receiver_acceptance_required: Real host emission -> SDK Logger -> OTLP/HTTP receiver; compare EventName, exact six Resource keys/schema URL, scope, times, severity, fixed Body, typed attributes, actual context, and no duplicate ingestion route.
Create one actual SDK span and export it; matching log carries exact context. Explicit no-span event has no context. Retry root links original; interleaved attempts cannot leak context.
Collect the exact cumulative monotonic operation/outcome Counter with exemplars disabled, finite 20-series set and no run/attempt labels.
Inject source/SQL/exception/header/subprocess sentinel strings and control characters; check every file, console, exporter, receiver and permitted artifact, including SDK self-diagnostics.

Exercise wrong config/SDK before effects; queue count+byte overflow, whole-event oversize, local segment/total cap, partial write, denied capture, exporter outage/slow or oversized response, retry ambiguity, no-active-span, deadline and all BaseException cancellation/cleanup cases.

Closed snapshot retrieval verifies hashes/byte limits/counters/ordering and supports source/line citations; open/expired/changed/unsafe files yield whole refusal. No post-close owned process/thread remains.

Compare synthetic host workflow with no-op and enabled diagnostics under a predeclared small functional overhead budget; receiver accuracy must be exact, no raw native or package qualification follows.
